title: Collatz: ordinary inverse optima, supplied-hit descent and joint-grid limits
body:
## Status and purpose

**OPEN research. This PR does not prove Collatz.** The latest pass attacks three proposed closing steps at their actual quantifiers: returning a supplied upper certificate to a useful ordinary source, excluding a bounded least-disagreement cycle by its whole predecessor basin, and bounding the shared-source many-clock statistic.

[Current proof packet](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/1f1d3d690d7517e1b2a44b5f2f4930bd45b63302/research/astra-diagonal-closure-20261125/README.md) · [Final Lean proposal and missing universal steps](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/1f1d3d690d7517e1b2a44b5f2f4930bd45b63302/research/astra-diagonal-closure-20261125/FINAL_PROPOSAL.md) · [Independent root review and frozen-source intake](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/1f1d3d690d7517e1b2a44b5f2f4930bd45b63302/reports/astra-diagonal-closure-20261125/ROOT_REVIEW.md)

## 1. Actual inverse-clock optima in the bounded bad-cycle branch

For the least odd tripling disagreement q, PR205's bounded branch has minimum s=(3q−1)/2. Every native k-odd window of cost A satisfies A≤B+2 against **all positive ordinary odd inverse paths** to the same endpoint with the same odd count, allowing arbitrary valuations. A competitor divisible by three can save at most one clock. At the minimum, the native cost is optimal; after the actual singleton merger, the exact unrestricted/multiple-of-three optima are (A,A+1), attained by s and 3q.

The written all-period assembly derives lap distortion ≤9/8 using only five-step residue counting and the explicit small-source check. A concrete 20-symbol reverse word, `12212122221212121211`, is excluded throughout the actual height strip by a two-clock cheaper ordinary rival z=(x+1)/4 divisible by three.

This does not exclude every candidate word. An ordinary CRT progression passes all 1,260 tested windows through depth 24 and all 22 tested paired optima; it does not form a cycle. Root's independent complete inverse-cost computation finds no uniform three-clock exclusion among native words through depth 17.

[Cycle argument and nine Lean declarations](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/1f1d3d690d7517e1b2a44b5f2f4930bd45b63302/research/astra-diagonal-closure-20261125/cycle/README.md) · [Independent review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/1f1d3d690d7517e1b2a44b5f2f4930bd45b63302/reports/astra-diagonal-closure-20261125/cycle/TRANSPORT_REVIEW.md)

## 2. Descent or a strictly cheaper suffix at the supplied upper hit

For an actual supplied hit T^H(3^j x)=1, the checked finite inequality gives a literal positive lower value below M by H when Q_H(x)≤M, Q_H(x)≤j+Q_H(3^j x)+D, and 3·3^D<2M. With the stated upper odd-cost bound, failure of that drop gives a first equal-grade clock strictly before H, a positive ordinary carry, and the **same remaining upper suffix with fewer odd departures**.

A separate arithmetic theorem repairs that carry to a genuine ternary pair when its own supplied hit and the upper endpoint's binary alignment are available. These hypotheses remain explicit.

The canonical family 81x+271=2^H has a three-odd upper first hit, but no lower phase through that entire hit shares its immediate successor with any tripled source. The exact unit-source test is n≡10 mod18. Thus the first-balance and one-successor routes cannot be declared universally complete from the saved odd work alone. The canonical examples are ordinary convergent controls, not counterexamples.

[Transport argument and eleven Lean declarations](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/1f1d3d690d7517e1b2a44b5f2f4930bd45b63302/research/astra-diagonal-closure-20261125/transport/README.md) · [Independent review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/1f1d3d690d7517e1b2a44b5f2f4930bd45b63302/reports/astra-diagonal-closure-20261125/transport/JOINT_REVIEW.md)

## 3. A lower bound defeats the bounded-menu joint-grid upper route

Two Lean ingredients prove clock-14 ordinary merger cylinders for all 81 suffixes, including the exact four-odd grade correction, and a finite forced-column-variation theorem on one common row set.

The written construction uses one seed pair and one shared binary string across all clocks. For λ=log_3(b/a)>0, the bounded-parameter enlargement has P_d(floor(d/3))≥λ/4 for all large rows at a sufficiently small positive clock fraction. Retaining genuine native survival still leaves a lower bound of order at least d^−1.

A separately reviewed extension realizes the two physical seeds and each completing grid residue using a single positive parent **of unrestricted height**. It can lie above the original source row. Different completions can use different parents. The required row population and true invariant-color replies are not constructed. The original physical-parent statistic and Collatz remain open.

[Joint argument and two Lean ingredients](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/1f1d3d690d7517e1b2a44b5f2f4930bd45b63302/research/astra-diagonal-closure-20261125/joint/README.md) · [Unrestricted-height realization](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/1f1d3d690d7517e1b2a44b5f2f4930bd45b63302/research/astra-diagonal-closure-20261125/joint/FEASIBLE_OPENINGS.md) · [Independent review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/1f1d3d690d7517e1b2a44b5f2f4930bd45b63302/reports/astra-diagonal-closure-20261125/joint/CYCLE_REVIEW.md)
